texts: For an all-arterial operation with a 90% LAD, a 60% circumflex marginal and an occluded right coronary artery, the best plan besides the LIMA to the LAD is the right IMA to the obtuse marginal and the left radial artery to the posterior descending artery.
The radial artery goes to the occluded right coronary system, where there is no native flow to compete with it.
The right IMA, an in situ artery, tolerates the moderate 60% marginal lesion better than a radial would.
He is right-handed with a normal Allen test, so the radial is taken from the non-dominant left arm.
The good saphenous veins are kept in reserve.
In the picture, the right vine curls to the acrobat and Franky lays the antenna from the left forearm onto the tarred rainbow.
Memory hook: the radial to the blocked rainbow, the mammaries to the living spikes.
